title: Prompt Template Management
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of classes and utilities for creating, managing, and formatting various types of prompt templates, including base templates, chat message templates, few-shot examples, and structured output prompts. It supports different formatting engines and loading mechanisms.

nodes.label: Base Prompt Template
nodes.title: Abstract Base Prompt Template
nodes.description: Defines the core interface and common functionalities for all prompt templates, including input variable validation, partial variable handling, and invocation methods.

nodes.label: Base Message Prompt Template
nodes.title: Abstract Base Message Prompt Template
nodes.description: Abstract base class for prompt templates that generate lists of chat messages, providing methods for formatting and managing input variables.

nodes.label: String Prompt Template
nodes.title: Base String Prompt Template
nodes.description: Extends BasePromptTemplate for templates that produce a single string output, handling formatting into a StringPromptValue.

nodes.label: Chat Message Prompt Template
nodes.title: Generic Chat Message Template
nodes.description: Formats a single chat message with a specified role and content, inheriting from BaseMessagePromptTemplate to generate chat messages.

nodes.label: AI Message Prompt Template
nodes.title: AI Message Template
nodes.description: Specialized chat message template for AI-generated messages, inheriting from BaseMessagePromptTemplate to represent AI's responses.

nodes.label: System Message Prompt Template
nodes.title: System Message Template
nodes.description: Specialized chat message template for system-level instructions or context, inheriting from BaseMessagePromptTemplate for system prompts.

nodes.label: Few-Shot Chat Message Template
nodes.title: Few-Shot Chat Prompt Template
nodes.description: Generates chat prompts with few-shot examples, either fixed or dynamically selected, by formatting individual example messages into a list of chat messages.

nodes.label: Few-Shot String Prompt Template
nodes.title: Few-Shot String Prompt Template
nodes.description: Creates string-based prompts incorporating few-shot examples, using a prefix, suffix, and an example prompt for formatting into a single string.

nodes.label: Structured Output Prompt
nodes.title: Prompt for Structured Output
nodes.description: A chat prompt template designed to guide language models to produce structured output based on a provided schema, often piped to an LLM with structured output capabilities.

nodes.label: Load Few-Shot Prompt
nodes.title: Load Few-Shot Prompt from Config
nodes.description: Utility function to load a FewShotPromptTemplate from a configuration dictionary, handling nested prompt and example loading from files or configs.

nodes.label: Load Prompt Template
nodes.title: Load Prompt Template from Config
nodes.description: Utility function to load a generic PromptTemplate from a configuration dictionary, including template content and output parser loading, with format validation.

nodes.label: Jinja2 Formatter
nodes.title: Jinja2 Template Formatter
nodes.description: Formats a template string using the Jinja2 templating engine, with security considerations for untrusted templates to prevent arbitrary code execution.

nodes.label: Mustache Formatter
nodes.title: Mustache Template Formatter
nodes.description: Formats a template string using the Mustache templating engine, providing a simple and logic-less way to render dynamic content.

nodes.label: Prompt Value
nodes.title: Abstract Prompt Output
nodes.description: Represents the abstract output of a prompt template, which can be a string or a list of messages, serving as a standardized prompt interface.

nodes.label: Base Message
nodes.title: Abstract Chat Message
nodes.description: Base class for all types of chat messages (e.g., Human, AI, System), providing a common interface for message content and metadata.

nodes.label: Base Example Selector
nodes.title: Abstract Example Selector
nodes.description: Interface for selecting examples to be included in few-shot prompts, often based on similarity or other criteria, to enhance prompt effectiveness.

nodes.label: Prompt Template (Concrete)
nodes.title: Concrete String Prompt Template
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of a string-based prompt template, used for simple text generation and formatting with input variables.

nodes.label: Chat Prompt Template (Concrete)
nodes.title: Concrete Chat Prompt Template
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of a chat-based prompt template, composed of multiple message prompt templates to construct a conversation.

nodes.label: Base Language Model
nodes.title: Abstract Language Model
nodes.description: Abstract base class for all language models, defining the interface for interacting with LLMs for text generation and other tasks.

groups.label: Base Prompt Definitions
groups.title: Core Prompt Template Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the fundamental abstract classes for all prompt templates, establishing common behaviors and properties for both string and message-based prompts.

groups.label: Chat Message Templates
groups.title: Specific Chat Message Types
groups.description: Provides concrete implementations for different roles within a chat conversation, such as AI, System, and generic chat messages, all building upon the base message prompt template.

groups.label: Few-Shot Prompting
groups.title: Templates for Few-Shot Learning
groups.description: Classes dedicated to incorporating few-shot examples into prompts, supporting both chat-based and string-based formats, with options for fixed or dynamic example selection.

groups.label: Structured Output Prompting
groups.title: Prompting for Structured Data
groups.description: A specialized chat prompt template designed to guide language models in generating output that conforms to a predefined schema, facilitating structured data extraction or generation.

groups.label: Prompt Loading Utilities
groups.title: Configuration-Based Prompt Loading
groups.description: Functions for loading prompt templates from configuration dictionaries, enabling dynamic creation and deserialization of various prompt types, including few-shot prompts.

groups.label: Template Formatters
groups.title: Dynamic Template String Formatting
groups.description: Utility functions that provide different templating engines (Jinja2, Mustache) for rendering prompt strings with dynamic variables, supporting flexible prompt construction.
